envelope.description: Pending-row deletes, meta updates and the by-target read keep the counts true

body.title: Pending-row deletes, meta updates and the by-target read keep the counts true
body.summary: deleteUnresolvedRowInTxn (src/db/relations.ts:463) removes the row's unresolved_by_target entry and decrements its class and reason counts in the same transaction, which covers deleteUnresolvedForFile (:312), deleteUnresolvedForRepoFile (:344) and deleteUnresolvedForRepo (:365) and their callers; updateUnresolvedMeta / updateUnresolvedMetaBatch merge meta (awaitsId, file, repo, specifier, exportedAs kept), move the counts on a class change and clear candidates on a class other than 'ambiguous'; listUnresolvedRelations gains opts.awaiting, reading rows awaiting the given ids from every repository through unresolved_by_target. Anchors: updateUnresolvedMeta (src/db/relations.ts:407) and updateUnresolvedMetaBatch (:442) replace meta today (`const next = { ...row, meta, attemptedAt }`, :417 and :453); deleteUnresolvedRowInTxn is at :463; listUnresolvedRelations (:277) scans the pending table without a file scope (:300-307). Depends on t3 for the by-target index writes it must undo. deleteUnresolvedRowInTxn has five callers: the three delete functions (:333, :360, :380) and the two promotions (promoteToResolved :403, promoteResolvedBatch :437). The helper decrements the removed row's class and reason counts; the promotions rely on it for that and add only the counts of what they write (an edge adds none; a re-keyed awaiting row adds its own), so no removal is counted twice.
acceptanceChecks: A kept-awaiting row is removed by deleteUnresolvedForFile(<absolute path>) and its count decremented; each of the three delete functions decrements what it removes
A reclass keeps awaitsId and specifier and clears stale candidates
listUnresolvedRelations with opts.awaiting returns two rows awaiting one id, one of them held by another repository, without scanning the pending table
A promotion that writes the edge leaves the class counts lowered by exactly one; one that re-keys an awaiting row leaves the awaiting count unchanged (no double decrement)

tests.name: src/db/__tests__/relations-pending-upkeep.test.ts: the three delete functions decrement counts and remove by-target entries; meta merge keeps awaitsId and clears stale candidates; listUnresolvedRelations opts.awaiting across repositories
